title: Bind supervisor dashboard projection to canonical TaskStore identity

not_changing: scripts/ai_status.py TaskStore loading and projection semantics
canonical journal, ai-status projection, archive, or fallback authority

failure_reproduction.cause: The supervisor cycle called ai_status.load_state without installing the live config's canonical TaskStore environment, so authoritative projection validation rejected the refresh for missing identity.
failure_reproduction.regression_contract: The test invokes the real canonical_task_state_identity_from_environment validator from inside the mocked ai_status.load_state boundary. The call can succeed only while all three exact values rendered by common.task_state_store_runtime_env are present.

implementation.scope: Only import/load/write_dashboard_bundle/sync_docs_site execute with the binding installed.
implementation.restoration: Every touched environment value is restored to its prior value, including deletion when it was originally absent.
implementation.fail_closed: Missing or malformed authoritative live config fails before ai_status import/load; the existing dashboard refresh error log receives the validation error.

verification.full_suite_result: 226 tests passed and 1 unrelated existing test errored in ReviewDecisionIntentLeaseRecoveryTests because its late scripts.ai_status import retained a task archive/status root binding mismatch. The failing test does not exercise dashboard refresh and neither scripts/ai_status.py nor archive binding code is changed by this task.
